problem: Existing embodied-AI simulators are narrowly tailored to specific tasks (navigation, manipulation, household), and none combines large indoor/outdoor scene sets, city-level interaction, multi-agent and human-robot tasks, and task-oriented fidelity on one platform.
motivation: General embodied intelligence needs a consistent environment where researchers can train and test from low-level navigation up to multi-agent social simulation and human-AI collaboration. A single unified platform with broad benchmarks would let different research communities share tools and evaluate agents across the full capability spectrum.
key_idea: Build a UE5-based general-purpose simulator (115 indoor scenes plus a contiguous outdoor town, Python API, NPC/crowd systems, parallel training) together with five benchmark categories spanning single-agent navigation to advanced social composite tasks.
insight: The benchmarks show that current agents are far below humans. PPO reaches 60% SR versus 100% for humans, A*+DWA and A*+MPPI score 10.4 and 43.1 versus 92.7 for human teleoperation, and the best MLLM averages only 24.53/100 on household composite tasks. Spatial intelligence (block building, puzzles, buttons) is the weakest domain and the embodied dimension in S3IT is the lowest, so spatial reasoning is a key bottleneck. Parallel training scales near-linearly before saturating from communication overhead.
method: Platform core: Unreal Engine 5.6 simulator with a Python SDK/UE server-client, scene manager giving GT semantics/segmentation/spawn points/navmesh, 28 interaction primitives, and ROS2 and VR support

Scenes: 115 indoor scenes expanded from designer-made ones via coarse-to-fine procedural generation (recombine functional room units, perturb/replace objects, human validation), plus a spatially contiguous outdoor town; importers for glTF/FBX/Datasmith

Agents and NPCs: humanoid and robot embodiments (e.g., Unitree Go2) with kinematic, target-driven and composite action spaces; NPCs controlled by rules, LLM/VLM and a social force model crowd of 100+ pedestrians
Experimental features: procedural IK-based locomotion, diffusion text-driven motion generation with voxel perception, MuJoCo and Isaac Lab integration for sim-to-real
Parallel training: multiple independent sub-levels loaded in one UE instance (48 envs shown), near-linear steps/s scaling on RTX 4090

Benchmarks: five categories: spatial exploration/navigation (paper-ball cleanup), MACS multi-agent search, robot social navigation, household composite tasks (8 tasks, 17 MLLMs), and S3IT seat-arrangement social intelligence (7,000 problems, 59 NPCs)

setting.backbone: Baselines: PPO, IPPO/MAPPO, A*+DWA/MPPI planners, and 17 frozen proprietary/open MLLMs (GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude etc.) via prompting
setting.training_data: RL baselines are trained in TongSIM environments; MLLMs are prompted only (no retraining)
setting.observation: Egocentric RGB, depth, voxel grid (19x19 local occupancy); multi-view RGB plus JSON scene descriptions for MLLMs; RGB-D, 3D LiDAR and GPS for social navigation; radial ray sensors for MACS
setting.action_space: Continuous 2D Box(-1,1) for MACS; move-to-coordinate/rotate for navigation; continuous ROS commands for the robot; high-level API calls (MoveToObject, PickUp) for MLLM agents
setting.privileged: Ground-truth scene metadata/JSON object descriptions provided to MLLM agents; otherwise none

results: Baselines on all five benchmarks fall well short of humans. PPO gets 60% SR versus 100% for humans, A*+MPPI gets 43.1 total versus 92.7 for human teleoperation, and the best MLLM (Gemini-2.5-Pro) averages 24.53 on household tasks and 47.8 on S3IT. MAPPO (19.24) beats IPPO (14.75) on MACS.
limitations: Baselines are simple and the benchmarks small in scale, and no comparison against other simulators on shared tasks is given
Sim-to-real integrations (MuJoCo, Isaac Lab), Flex and several other features are experimental, and no real-robot experiments are reported
Fidelity claims are largely qualitative; the evaluation is limited to a few tasks and lightly tuned baselines
